mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% monthly growth indicate strong consumer demand, which signals robust corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both increased by >0.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE declines, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) over the prior 3 months signals strong economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 has grown over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals weakening economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and tight labor markets (UNRATE < 4.5%), the combined signal indicates a strong economy with elevated discount rates, which typically leads to negative equity returns due to reduced risk appetite over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high interest rate and tight labor market regime
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In low housing market conditions (HOUST < 2000.0), a subsequent increase in housing starts signals a recovery in the real estate sector, which boosts consumer confidence and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where HOUST < 2000.0 and HOUST increases, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
